changelog:
Guide discovery that gives up on time, and gentler checks against your provider.

WHAT CHANGED

- When the app looks for your provider's guide address, it now stops within about 18 seconds even if the provider's server never answers. Before, one silent server could hold that search for much longer.
- A provider whose guide file is very small, such as an empty guide, is now found. Before, it was wrongly treated as having no guide.
- If the search finds nothing, the guide address you already had is kept.
- Checking which channels work still spaces its requests apart and never runs more at once than your provider allows. That rule is now shared, so any future per-channel check follows it too.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Search, browsing and the guide look and behave as before.

NOT YET

- Searching programme titles in the guide. It was considered and set aside for now.
- Faster search on very large catalogs, which waits on measurements taken on a phone.
